entries.sense_en: listen carefully; pay attention

synonyms.nuance: Ordinary word; no command tone or old-fashioned flavor.
Equally old and poetic; shorter, more like a sudden call to listen.
Means to pay attention and act on advice, not just hear.

entries.sense_en: very sharp and sensitive (of a sense)

synonyms.nuance: Warm, everyday word for sharp senses or interest.
Most general; also used for pain, minds and edges.
Reacts easily, sometimes too easily; not necessarily better than normal.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절: [əˈkjut].

entries.sense_en: stayed in my mind and troubled me again and again

synonyms.nuance: Stronger: the thought takes over your whole mind, often 'be obsessed with'.
Suggests real suffering caused by the thought or person.
Milder and more general; a worry that bothers you.

entries.sense_en: treated unfairly or harmed

synonyms.nuance: Physical or general damage; does not stress unfairness.
Ongoing bad treatment, usually of a person or animal.
Hurts feelings or pride, not necessarily a real injury.
synonyms.example: I didn't mean to offend you.

entries.tip_ko: 동사 wrong(부당하게 대하다)은 문어체 용법이라 일상에서는 드묾.

entries.sense_en: a large bird that eats dead animals

synonyms.nuance: A hunting bird that kills live prey; proud, not creepy like a vulture.
In the US a kind of vulture; in Britain a hawk-like bird.

entries.tip_ko: eagle과 달리 vulture는 썩은 고기를 먹는 새라 불길한 이미지.

entries.sense_en: a thin cloudy layer covering something

synonyms.nuance: A layer put on purposely, like paint or oil.
Neutral and general; can be thick or thin.
Poetic; a thin covering that hides what is behind.

entries.tip_ko: 영화라는 뜻만 알기 쉽지만 여기서는 눈 위의 '막'.

entries.sense_en: I was suddenly filled with fear or horror

synonyms.nuance: Lighter; often a shock of fear or excitement.
synonyms.example: The noise sent shivers down my spine.

synonyms.nuance: Stronger; you cannot move at all from fear.
Fear mixed with disgust, from something creepy or unpleasant.
synonyms.example: The way he stared made my skin crawl.

entries.sense_en: slowly, step by step

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; the standard modern choice.
Informal and spoken; stresses small steps.
Suggests clear stages in a process.

entries.sense_en: decided firmly

synonyms.nuance: Simple and neutral; does not stress the struggle before choosing.
Formal; a firm decision to do something difficult.
Choose one thing among several options.

entries.sense_en: get free from something unwanted

synonyms.nuance: The everyday spoken form of the same phrase.
Suggests escaping something that holds you.
Informal: escape something that follows or clings to you.

entries.sense_en: hiding one's true feelings or plans

synonyms.nuance: General word: making someone believe something false.
Pretending to have virtues or beliefs one does not have.
Acting as if something is true; can be harmless play.

entries.tip_ko: simulation(꾸밈)과 헷갈리기 쉽지만 dissimulation은 감추는 것.

entries.sense_en: a small metal bar that fastens a door

synonyms.nuance: A sliding bar, heavier and stronger than a latch.
Needs a key to open; a latch usually does not.
Small fastener for a door or box; near-synonym.

entries.sense_en: an old lamp with a shutter that can cover its light
entries.sense_ko: (덮개로 빛을 가릴 수 있는) 등불, 암등

synonyms.nuance: Modern electric torch you switch on and off.
Any lamp with a protective case; not necessarily hideable.
British word for a flashlight.

entries.sense_en: push quickly and firmly

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; no sense of sudden or forceful movement.
Rough, careless push, often at people.
Push a short thing or finger into or at something.

entries.tip_ko: thrust-thrust-thrust로 형태가 모두 같음.

entries.sense_en: in a clever, sly way that avoids being noticed

synonyms.nuance: Neutral and positive; no sense of trickery.
Quietly secretive, often with a smile.
Very close in meaning; stresses planning to deceive.

entries.sense_en: annoyed or troubled

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and milder; a small irritation.
Repeated small things that build up anger.
synonyms.example: It irritates me when he taps.

synonyms.nuance: Much stronger; deep, lasting suffering.

entries.sense_en: very wise and deep in understanding

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for good judgment from experience.
Common and general; can be physical or emotional.
Sees hidden truths quickly; often used for remarks.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절: [prəˈfaʊnd].

entries.sense_en: wise, sharp judgment

synonyms.nuance: Deep knowledge from experience; less about quick judgment.
Quick practical judgment, often about money or people.
Ability to see the truth of a situation.

entries.sense_en: laughed quietly

synonyms.nuance: Higher, silly, often nervous laughing.
Happy, satisfied laugh; a bit louder than a chuckle.
Quiet, unkind laugh at someone.

entries.sense_en: completely dark

synonyms.nuance: Same idea as one word; used before nouns too.
Common variant, especially for night or eyes.
Weaker and more general.

entries.sense_en: held back; kept quiet

synonyms.nuance: Made quieter by a covering, not by holding it in.
Formal; deliberately kept from showing.
Covered so much it can hardly be heard or seen.

entries.sense_en: a mix of great fear and wonder

synonyms.nuance: Pleasant amazement without fear.
Pure fear about something bad coming.
Deep respect, often religious.

entries.sense_en: the chest, seen as the place of deep feelings

synonyms.nuance: Physical front of the upper body; no feeling implied.
The most common word for inner feelings.
Old-fashioned or poetic word for the chest.

entries.tip_ko: oo가 짧은 [ʊ]: '부점'에 가깝게 발음.

entries.sense_en: drove mad with worry; badly disturbed

synonyms.nuance: Interrupt or upset the calm.
Make you uneasy but not crazy.
Cause deep, lasting suffering.

entries.tip_ko: '주의를 산만하게 하다'가 아니라 옛 뜻 '정신을 못 차리게 하다'.

entries.sense_en: moved slowly and menacingly toward its prey, like a hunter

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; just go behind.
Move low and quietly.
Move about quietly, like a hunter looking for prey.

entries.sense_en: wrapped completely; covered all around

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for putting something around.
General; does not stress surrounding fully.
Swallow up; suggests something large or dangerous.

entries.tip_ko: 동사 envelop [ɪnˈvɛləp]와 명사 envelope [ˈɛnvəloʊp]는 발음이 다름.

entries.sense_en: a low sound made in pain or fear

synonyms.nuance: Longer and softer; can show pain or sadness.
Breath of tiredness or relief; not pain.
Small, weak, crying sound.

entries.sense_en: a narrow opening or crack

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; a break in a surface.
Space between two things; not a break.
Long, thin, cut-like opening.

entries.sense_en: quietly and secretly so no one notices

synonyms.nuance: Not shown to others; no stress on quiet movement.
Nervous, guilty; with quick looks around.
Informal; a little childish or dishonest.

entries.tip_ko: stealth의 ea는 [ɛ], th는 [θ].

entries.sense_en: the soft inner part of bones

synonyms.nuance: The center of anything.
The hard part around marrow.
The most important quality of something.

entries.tip_ko: chilled the marrow in my bones는 '뼛속까지 오싹하다'는 표현.

entries.sense_en: a fast, steady beating sound

synonyms.nuance: Any single or repeated rhythm.
Repeated hitting, like on a drum.
Strong regular pulse of a heart or pain.

entries.tip_ko: 문신 tattoo와 철자는 같지만 어원이 다른 단어로, 원래 군대의 귀영 북소리를 뜻함.

entries.sense_en: a loud sharp cry

synonyms.nuance: General loud voice; often to be heard.
High cry of fear or pain.
Neutral; may be words or sounds.

entries.sense_en: let out a sharp, high scream

synonyms.nuance: Ordinary word for a loud cry of fear or pain.
Harsh and ugly, like brakes or a bird.
Short, sharp cry, usually of an animal or sudden pain.

entries.sense_en: quiet because something covered it

synonyms.nuance: Without sharpness; can be sound, light, or pain.
Weak, far away.
Deliberately or gently made quiet.

entries.sense_en: the regular beating of the heart

synonyms.nuance: Normal word for the heartbeat you can feel.
One beat, or the beating itself.
Stronger, often painful beat.

entries.sense_en: was passing; was coming to its end

synonyms.nuance: Slowly lose strength or color.
Become lower or weaker, often in quality.
Flow back like the tide; slower and poetic.

entries.tip_ko: wane(줄어들다)은 wax(차오르다)의 반대말, 달과 자주 씀.

entries.sense_en: cut the limbs from a body

synonyms.nuance: General and plain; any cutting into pieces.
Cutting cooked meat or shapes with care.
Damage badly, not always cutting apart.

entries.sense_en: hiding something so it is not found

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; plain and neutral.
Hiding wrongdoing from authorities.
State of keeping things secret, not the act of hiding one thing.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절: [kənˈsilmənt].

entries.sense_en: small wooden beams under a floor

synonyms.nuance: Large, strong piece of wood holding weight.
Beam that holds up a floor or ceiling.
Slanted beam holding up a roof.

entries.sense_en: careful and watchful against danger

synonyms.nuance: General word for taking care.
Slow to act because of possible risk.
Thinks someone is doing wrong.

entries.tip_ko: weary(지친)와 혼동 주의: wary [ˈwɛri]는 '경계하는'.

entries.sense_en: smooth, polite manner

synonyms.nuance: Basic good manners.
Ability to attract and please people.
Refined, cultured manner from experience.

entries.tip_ko: 형용사 suave [swɑv]와 함께 기억.

entries.sense_en: officially chosen and sent to do a job

synonyms.nuance: Choose someone for a role or job.
Give a specific task.
Hand over a task or power to someone.

entries.sense_en: criminal action, especially murder

synonyms.nuance: Any illegal act.
Killing on purpose; foul play often hints at it.
Breaking rules unfairly in a game.

entries.tip_ko: 뉴스의 'foul play suspected'는 살인 등 범죄 의심.

entries.sense_en: boldness and daring

synonyms.nuance: Neutral or positive courage.
Informal: rude courage.
synonyms.example: He had the nerve to ask.

synonyms.nuance: British informal; mild rudeness.

entries.sense_en: lay resting

synonyms.nuance: Simple word for lying still.
Everyday word; be flat somewhere.
Lean back or lie back comfortably.

entries.sense_en: said (a greeting) to; 'bid someone welcome' = welcome them

synonyms.nuance: The plain modern verb for 'bid welcome'.
Say hello on meeting; no sense of inviting someone in.
synonyms.example: He greeted me at the door.

synonyms.nuance: Old 'bid' can also mean order, as in 'I bade them search'; 'tell' is the modern word.

entries.tip_ko: bid의 옛 과거형 bade는 [bæd]로 bad와 같게 발음(영국식은 [beɪd]도).

entries.sense_en: before much time had passed

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; the normal choice.
A bit formal; within a short time.
Modern equivalent used in speech.

entries.sense_en: wild movements of the hands and arms while talking

synonyms.nuance: Any movement of hands or body that shows meaning.
Moving hands back and forth.
Body movements in general.

entries.sense_en: talked wildly like a madman

synonyms.nuance: Angry, long speech; still has a point.
Show strong anger; not always talk.
Talk fast without sense.

entries.tip_ko: rave는 '열광적으로 칭찬하다'는 뜻도 있음.

entries.sense_en: back and forth

synonyms.nuance: Everyday modern phrase; same meaning.
Movement along a line.
Walk again and again from side to side.

entries.sense_en: contempt shown by laughing at someone

synonyms.nuance: Making fun of someone.
Speaking of someone as silly.
Strong contempt, not always with laughter.

entries.sense_en: falsely pretending to feel something one does not feel

synonyms.nuance: Not meaning what you say; milder.
Informal: says different things to different people.
Everyday word for anything not real.

entries.sense_en: hide your real feelings or intentions

synonyms.nuance: Act as if something is true; can be play.
Formal: fake a feeling or illness.
General; anything hidden.

entries.sense_en: wicked people; criminals

synonyms.nuance: Someone who broke the law.
Old-fashioned; dishonest man.
Playful; a mischievous person.

entries.tip_ko: 마지막 -ain은 [ən]: '빌런'.
